_: CHEW THROUGH — deeps_2. Re-run with: tools/shot.sh --seq=tools/seq/deeps_2.json

__: twice — the human stopped dead by the 21-frame cracked_stone at beat 1 with the
___: after shot beside it, and the FROG mid-hold on the 28-frame packed wall at

_: SCREEN A (cols 0-24, rows 0-14) — BEAT 1, THE CRUMB WALL.
__: Spawn at (3,12) with the cracked_stone plug at col 9 six tiles dead ahead:
___: grey masonry in a brown gallery, the first thing in the level, and the one

_: Pressed flat against it, running right with nothing held but right. This is
__: the sixty seconds of the level where a player learns the verb exists: the
___: corridor is two tiles tall, the grey plug fills both of them, and the gems
____: are visible on the far side of it.

_: And open. Twenty-one accumulated 1/60ths if she shoulders it; instantly if she
__: throws the blade, which is what `attack` does in her hands and why beat 1
___: is the beat that needs no new button at all.

_: THE ARC. The long way round the same wall, and the reason the route can be
__: proved at all: the ladder at col 6 she walked over, the shelf at stand 6,
___: and the fall at cols 18-19 back onto the gallery east of the plug. The
____: rubble set INTO the gallery's floor at (16,13) is in this frame too.

_: SCREEN C (cols 0-24, rows 15-29) — BEAT 2, BREAK HIGH OR WALK LOW.
__: Standing on the high line between the two answers: the cracked_dirt wall at
___: col 11 to the west (sixteen frames) and the two-column pit at cols 15-16 to
____: the east, which drops onto the low line the declared route takes.

_: What the wall was worth: a heart, two gems and a BARK BEETLE that cannot
__: follow you out — walker.gd turns on missing ground even while chasing, and
___: the shelf's floor stops at col 6.

_: SCREEN D (cols 25-49, rows 15-29) — the cellar, walked flat across the

_: BEAT 3, THE LUMINOUS VAULT. Take the pad — this beat is met as the frog by
__: construction, and the frog has `can_attack: false`, so the hold is the only
___: verb there is. Then onto the first tread (a one-way, so aim row 23) facing
____: the luminous_wall at col 32 with a heart behind it.

_: The form-change banner ('FROG', drawn over the middle of the screen) is
__: still up 60 frames after the pad fires and it lands right across the vault.
___: Wait it out rather than capture through it.

_: The exit alcove, on the far side of that wall — and also the bottom of the
